descriptor.name: Vermont SPAN assessment parcels
descriptor.operator: Vermont Center for Geographic Information / local municipalities
descriptor.scope: SPAN-identified Grand List assessment accounts at Montpelier, assembled by complete native-account manifests; unidentified exempt shapes excluded.
caveats: Represents Grand List assessment account boundaries by publisher SPAN; an account may contain multiple mapped/legal lots and is not asserted to be one legal cadastral lot.
Unidentified exempt rail, road and water polygons with null SPAN are excluded consistently.
Montpelier sampled data use 2025 parcel and Grand List years; capital-area acceptance does not establish full municipal coverage.

sourceNote: VCGI SPAN-identified Grand List assessment accounts; legal-lot multiplicity is not inferred. Current sampled parcel and Grand List year is 2025.
